corpus_metadata.ruleName: Iframe with interactive elements is not excluded from tab-order

evaluation.label: passed
evaluation.overall_assessment: The page contains a single iframe with an inline document containing a standard anchor link. WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard): The anchor link inside the iframe is natively keyboard accessible via Tab and Enter, with no custom widgets or event handlers that would block keyboard access. WCAG 2.2.1 (Timing Adjustable): There are no time limits present on this page. WCAG 2.4.3 (Focus Order): The only focusable element is the anchor link inside the iframe; the focus order is logical and meaningful. WCAG 2.4.7 (Focus Visible): Native browser focus indicators apply to the anchor link, and nothing in the HTML suppresses them (no outline:none or tabindex=-1 misuse). WCAG 2.5.5 (Target Size): While target size cannot be fully determined from HTML alone, the anchor is a standard inline link rendered by the browser with default sizing; no evidence of unusually small targets exists. All evaluated criteria are satisfied.
